definitions.siteVersion: jamesdare.com package.json version when these figures were generated
definitions.passionVersion: passion-agent package.json version on the machine that generated these figures
definitions.stars: GitHub stargazers on DareDev256/fcp-mcp-server, read live when these figures were last generated
definitions.forks: GitHub forks of DareDev256/fcp-mcp-server, read live when these figures were last generated
definitions.installs: PyPI downloads of fcp-mcp-server in the last 30 days, via pypistats
definitions.clientSites: client sites in the roster at /data/client-sites.json, each one named and linked on the page
definitions.clientSitesUp: how many of those answered a request when these figures were generated
definitions.wikiReverted: edits by RawBOT that MediaWiki tagged mw-reverted, in the most recent 500 sampled
definitions.wikiRevertSample: how many recent edits were examined — the API returns at most 500, so this is a sample and not an all-time rate
definitions.wikiStood: recent edits by RawBOT that no editor reverted
definitions.wikiRevertRate: share of the sampled edits that were reverted, per MediaWiki's own mw-reverted tag
definitions.wikiShare: RawBOT's share of every edit ever made on ninonline.fandom.com, read live from the MediaWiki API
definitions.wikiEdits: edits made by RawBOT on ninonline.fandom.com, per the MediaWiki API
definitions.wikiTotal: every edit by every editor on ninonline.fandom.com since 2013, per the MediaWiki API
definitions.repos: gh repo list DareDev256, all visibilities
definitions.loc: all first-party .mjs, excluding node_modules and test dirs
definitions.jobs: com.daredev.* loaded on the MacBook + enabled on the Mac Mini
definitions.reposArchived: archived repositories, excluded from active counts
definitions.services: live SSH probe of the Mac Mini loopback ports at build time; unreachable means the host did not answer
definitions.snapshotDate: when data/system-snapshot.json was last generated — the date every stamp on this page reads from

directedViews.note: sum of public view counts on directed films

directedViewsShort.note: the same view total, rounded for the stat block — derived from directedViews, never typed twice

directedFilms.note: music videos directed, counted by hand

directedArtists.note: distinct artists directed for, counted by hand
